newsitem.title: YEMEN: British minister encourages investment in Yemen.
newsitem.headline: British minister encourages investment in Yemen.

text.p: British Trade Minister Anthony Nelson on Sunday called on his country's businessmen to invest in Yemen, state television reported.

The television said Nelson called on British businessmen to "capitalise on investment opportunities" in the $500 million Aden free zone, just outside the Red Sea's southern entrance. It is expected to start operating in 1999.
Nelson also told reporters he would seek to provide guarantees to British investors in Yemen, a small oil producer of 16 million people.
Nelson, accompanied by about 50 businessmen, arrived in Sanaa on Friday and left on Sunday.
Impoverished Yemen is hoping the Aden free zone will boost its economy, hit by a brief civil war in 1994 but slowly improving under reforms agreed with the International Monetary Fund.
